question:
A @ B means 'A is the husband of B'.

A & B means 'A is the mother of B'.

A # B means 'A is the daughter of B'.

A % B means 'A is the sister of B'.

If R # L % G @ V & P, then how is L related to P?
solution:

**Statement :** R # L % G @ V & P

So, according to the given symbols :​

 
• R # L → R is the Daughter of L.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/486d2bd53ef5196eac6a7f2cdfa721abf500a6d9d8baf0286a62c4523f3256b0.png] 

 
• L % G → L is the sister of G.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ba6707f78be0046abb8a4bbbfa81fcd9be67f196f394ca1932c2283007d776c.png] 

 
• G @ V → G is husband of V.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2124c20ed4fed1a8744d07a373e364ffaf1396f8c2126415e76bf96d6a68c709.png] 

 
• V & P → V is he mother of P.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0d321cdb879e624a21dfe6585122c60c947afe2abf9e4f9368faf2c3741e6e1.png] 

Thus, according to the final family tree L is the maternal aunt i.e father's sister of P.

Hence, "Option - (2)" is the correct answer.
